title: How Three Teens Put an Elementary School in Lockdown
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On March 15, 2023, police responded to a threats complaint at an elementary school in La Crosse, WI. Three teenagers in a vehicle had driven by and threatened children on the playground. News of the incident spread among numerous students, leading to several of them crying and feeling terrified. This triggered panic throughout the school, prompting a subsequent lockdown. Video surveillance quickly identified the vehicle and revealed its association with several prior incidents. An officer conducted a traffic stop, and due to the individuals' history, multiple officers assisted with the situation.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
